name: Audio Bars Opacity
description: Six synchronized vertical bars with opacity fade animation

variations.name: default
variations.description: Six vertical bars fading in and out as they grow and shrink, creating a ghosting wave effect

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: barWidth

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
